claims.summary: The selected JSON resolves small student and wide teacher models and the stated hyperparameters.
The teacher checkpoint is loaded on CPU, parameters are frozen, and its forward pass uses evaluation mode without gradients.
Cross-entropy and temperature-scaled batch-mean KL are separated and then weighted 0.4/0.6.
Adam owns student parameters only, so the shown backward and step path updates only the student.
Validation runs after each epoch without gradients and prints accuracy; it does not select a checkpoint.
After the loop, the final student state_dict alone is written to the configured relative path.
The artifact correctly leaves teacher checkpoint existence, compatibility, provenance, and quality unresolved.
The expected keys and loader flow are source-supported, while tensor contents and runtime validation results remain unknown.
Inference is identified as context rather than part of the selected training execution path.
